what_this_is: The CURRENT deployment pins, in two blocks that are two different facts. `live` is what production serves: the deployment record's own numbers, moved ONLY by a deployment-authorization order. `source` is what a FRESH assembly of the committed source produces: moved by an application order, which puts source AHEAD of production until the next deploy. When the two agree, ahead_of_production is false and moved_by is null. Consumed historical authorizations are never restated here; they live in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations and are immutable evidence of what was authorized at the time (see supersessions.json).

source.note: Source and production are IN SYNC.
